== Geography ==

The park has a surface of 47 square kilometres (18 mi2) and covers part of the city of  Bergamo and of the surrounding municipalities. The largest part of the surface of the park is covered by woods.  The fauna of the park  includes foxes, European badgers and others mammals, while the European robin is the most widespread bird.
The highest point of the park is Canto Alto at 1,144 metres (3,753 ft) above sea level; the lowest point is at 244 metres (801 ft).
The park is crossed by the Morla and Quisa rivers.
